purpose: Corrected raw-ABI trace of the LIVERY template call through the generic type-1 UI object factory. It establishes this call as text-object initialization and a negative PTG-load route; it does not identify the actual consumer of all LIVERY PTGs.

instructions.assembly: delay slot sw v1,0x138(sp); v1 previously set to 0x18 terminator

raw_callsite.interpretation: Argument a0 is copied to the value slot following property key 0x6d in the outgoing UI-object property list. It is not unused, and the decompiler prototype under-reports the raw argument packing.

factory_and_property_route.type1_registration: FUN_001485f0 calls FUN_0014d568(1); FUN_0014d568 calls FUN_0014be98(1), which assigns DAT_00236d20[1] = FUN_0014bed0.
factory_and_property_route.constructor: FUN_00148468 allocates an object and dispatches (object,type,&property_list) through DAT_00236d20[type].
factory_and_property_route.parser: FUN_0014bed0 initializes the type-1 object then calls FUN_00145b08(object,property_list). Case 0x6d dispatches to DAT_00239070[type].
factory_and_property_route.setter: FUN_0014d568(1) calls FUN_0014ddc8(1); this assigns DAT_00239070[1] = FUN_0014e298.
factory_and_property_route.string_storage: FUN_0014e298 obtains string length, allocates length+1 units in type-1 object field +0x140, and copies the string via FUN_001017e8. This is the text/string buffer path.

conclusion.status: negative route proven; actual 136-file LIVERY loader/draw consumer unresolved
conclusion.claim: The 0x25a1d0 LIVERY template call initializes a type-1 UI object string field. Its source path does not open, parse, or upload a LIVERY PTG.
conclusion.limit: This excludes only the observed FUN_00173938 → FUN_0015b280 route. It does not prove no other LIVERY PTG consumer exists elsewhere.
